coverage.basis: Static text only; URLs may be assets, telemetry or unused code. Relative paths are candidates, not verified endpoints.
coverage.limitations: No requests sent, execution, base URL joins, dynamic string reconstruction, or proof of route reachability. Obfuscated annotations and computed paths may be missed.
coverage.json_path_candidates: Strings under JSON path/paths ancestors are configuration-declared candidates. They may be local routes, templates, or unused paths; HTTP methods and matching hosts are unknown.
